class_definition: positive-weight finite mixtures of A5 orbits at finitely many positive radii, hop symbol sum w [1 - cos(a k r u.n)], continuum k^2 normalization, no independent isotropic counterterm; invariance forces equal weights inside each orbit and the cosine form is even

class_statements.isotropic_floor: B0/C4^2 = (10/21)(mu2 mu6/mu4^2) >= 10/21, equality exactly on single-radius members
class_statements.rank_purity: ranks one through five empty and rank six on the I6 line, consumed from the universality certificate
class_statements.rank_six_band: every member has B6/B0 = (16/75) <I6(seed)> with positive weights w |O| r^6, confined to [-16/135, 16/75]; single-radius members reduce the weights to w |O|

eighth_order.fixed_point_template_crosscheck: the vertex D6 = -a^6/118125 equals half the -2/118125 x^8 coefficient of the certified through-eighth template
eighth_order.sign_alternation: positive even moments and the alternating cosine series give isotropic coefficients of sign (-1)^(m+1) at order k^(2m) for every member
eighth_order.statement: the degree-eight kernel factors as 20/3 plus (256/75) I6(u) I6(n), the rank-eight multiplicity is zero, every branch has D0 = -a^6/60480 with D6/D0 = (64/125) I6(seed) in the band [-64/225, 64/125], and the cross-order ratio (D6/D0)/(B6/B0) locks at 12/5 on single-radius members; the isotropic tower alternates in sign at every order

frozen_receipt_crosscheck.statement: the frozen FZ-11 and FZ-12 receipts carry exactly the vertex and edge values of the class coefficient map; the comparison is read-only and changes no frozen bytes

kernel_factorization.completeness_argument: the kernel is right-translation invariant in the seed, the recomputed invariant multiplicities (1,0,0,0,0,0,1) through level six pin the degree-six invariant space to the span of the radial power and the I6 form, and residue-zero at seeds with distinct I6 values determines the identity on that two-dimensional space; the extra seeds are redundancy
kernel_factorization.degree_two_and_four_group_sums: isotropic with constants 20 and 12 at every seed, closing the generic-orbit isotropy of the second and fourth moments
kernel_factorization.statement: sum over the sixty rotations of ((g u).n)^6 equals 60/7 plus (64/35) I6(u) I6(n) on the unit sphere in both arguments, for every seed direction

kill_surface: a resolved intrinsic dispersion with B0/C4^2 below 10/21, or B6/B0 outside [-16/135, 16/75], or a rank one-to-five residue, or a rank-six residue off the rotated I6 line, excludes the complete stable icosahedral finite-range class; saturation of the floor at 10/21 certifies a single-radius carrier
physical_premises_unchanged: sector, frame, scale, and exclusivity premises of FZ-11 and FZ-12 stay open and owned by issues #655, #666, and #664; this certificate adds no comparison and reads no data

signed_control.verdict: below the floor, so positivity cannot be dropped

radial_floor.statement: mu2 mu6 - mu4^2 is the positive Lagrange combination of (r_i^2 - r_j^2)^2 terms, so B0/C4^2 >= 10/21 for every positive-weight member with equality exactly at one radius; a signed-weight control violates the floor, so strict positivity is load-bearing
